groups.name: Real routes
groups.note: Route map on real streets, water and 3D buildings. Name two places or give it a GPX file.

items.name: Tower Bridge to St Paul's
items.does: A 1.4 mile walk through real London
items.key: The last street completes, the pin lands and the real trip time punches
items.cmd: /animate-route-map Tower Bridge to St Paul's Cathedral, walking

items.name: Millennium Park to Navy Pier
items.does: A 1.8 mile drive along the Chicago lakefront
items.key: The last street completes, the pin lands and the real trip time punches
items.cmd: /animate-route-map Millennium Park to Navy Pier, Chicago

items.name: Palace of Fine Arts to the Wharf
items.does: A 2.2 mile bike ride along the San Francisco bay
items.key: The last street completes, the pin lands and the real trip time punches
items.cmd: /animate-route-map Palace of Fine Arts to Fisherman's Wharf, by bike

groups.name: Big visuals
groups.note: Spectacle that works for any topic. Each one turns an idea into something physical you can look at.

items.name: Iceberg
items.does: A small tip hides a colossal mass under the waterline
items.key: The base ignites and the hero line stamps

items.name: Scale reveal
items.does: A big number rises past real things at true scale
items.key: The stack clears the last comparison and the height punches

items.name: Cutaway
items.does: A blade of light slices an object open down to its core
items.key: The core ignites and a ripple runs out ring by ring

items.name: Campaign map
items.does: Bold arrows sweep across a real map, like a history documentary
items.key: The final arrow plants and the whole sweep is revealed

groups.name: Made with /explain
groups.note: Whole explainers, each from one sentence. Shown here as silent previews; yours are narrated in your own voice.

items.name: Glass widgets

groups.name: Claude Code

items.name: Terminal run
items.does: A session plays out from one prompt to a finished result
items.key: The mascot lands on the green result slab

items.name: Agent fan out
items.does: One prompt splits into six subagents, each with its own mascot
items.key: The last agent finishes and they pile onto the result

items.name: Agent loop
items.does: The mascot laps Plan, Act and Check until the tests pass
items.key: Check turns green and the ring cracks open

items.name: Test sweep
items.does: A wall of failing tests flips green in a wave
items.key: The last test lands on the exact total

items.name: Bug hunt
items.does: The mascot surfs a scrolling file until it finds the bug
items.key: The line locks and the lens slams up

items.name: File tree
items.does: A codebase grows branch by branch behind the mascot
items.key: The tree pulls back and the file count lands

items.name: Diff reveal
items.does: The mascot eats the red lines of a real-looking diff
items.key: The last gulp and the final removed count

items.name: Hours collapse
items.does: A full day of hour blocks gets stomped into minutes
items.key: The new time slams in over the old one

items.name: Cost receipt
items.does: A till receipt prints line items for a session
items.key: The total is stamped on the receipt

items.name: Benchmark takeover
items.does: The mascot rides a huge row into a serious leaderboard
items.key: The row seats and #1 stamps

groups.note: These use Claude Code's look, the Claude logo and its pixel mascot. They run on sample content until you tell Claude what to show, and you can turn the mascot or logo off.
